opening.argument: The speaker grounds a forecast of Cardano falling to 19.6 cents or even 15 cents in RSI readings and bearish divergence. That is technical market analysis, not a promise of profit or a guaranteed investment outcome. The channel also promotes memberships, Patreon access and daily Discord updates, but the description says the video is for entertainment, disclaims financial advice and warns that crypto can lose viewers money. Its notice about anyone claiming affiliation who solicits money or offers to manage a trading account is a warning to viewers, not evidence that the speaker makes those requests.
